# proprietary-files.txt - Meizu M3 Note Intl (l681), MT6755
#
# PROVENANCE (FACT): the body below is copied unmodified on 2026-09-16 from
#   /srv/forge/android/l681/lineage14.1-m3note/vendor/meizu/l681h/proprietary-files.txt
#   (195 lines), which its own header records as auto-generated by
#   `mt6755_tree_stage` - the same tool that produced the 1002-entry m681 list
#   from the stock Flyme 6.2.0.2A dump. So every blob named here is a
#   Flyme/Nougat-era MTK binary. That is the root reason this tree is non-Treble
#   and carries no BOARD_VNDK_VERSION.
#
# THE BLOBS ARE NOT ON THIS DISK (FACT, verified 2026-09-16):
#   vendor/meizu/l681h/proprietary  -> empty directory (0 B)
#   vendor/meizu/l681h/flyme_system -> 0 files
#   There is no l681 stock Flyme dump under /srv/forge/android either (the only
#   Meizu stock dumps present are m681/Flyme6.2.0.2A, meizu_m6/
#   stock-flyme-7.1.2.0G and /srv/forge/m6t-dump).
#   => This list is an INVENTORY, not an extraction. Someone has to pull the
#   blobs off REDACTED_UNIT (or find an l681 Flyme image) before it is usable.
#
# DO NOT SUBSTITUTE THE m681 LIST. The campaign rule "never use l681 artifacts
# as m681 truth" (meizu-fleet/factbase/mt6755_family.md:303-304) cuts both ways:
# m681 is the CN M3 Note on Flyme 6.2.0.2A, l681 is the international one, and
# at minimum their panels differ (m681 panel unrecorded; l681 selects
# hx8399_fhd_dsi_vdo_txd_auo_al1518, see BoardConfig.mk) and their camera
# sensors differ (l681: CAM[1] ov13853mipiraw, CAM[2] ov5670mipiraw, read from
# /proc/driver/camera_info on the live unit; m681's stock 3.10 opens s5k5e8yx
# id 0x5e80 + ov13853).
#
# NOT YET DONE (honest status):
#   - this list has NOT been audited against Android 13; the Nougat HIDL-less
#     RIL stack and the audio/camera blobs are known-doubtful there;
#   - the LOS 14.1 tree additionally pulls ~40 framework-shadowing libraries
#     through a filter-out in its device.mk because the Flyme copies break
#     vold/zygote/media startup - that whole mechanism has to be re-derived on
#     A13, not copied.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Auto-generated from mt6755_tree_stage.
# Clean up entries only after the first bring-up succeeds.
#
# BLOB AUDIT 2026-09-16 (fleet hygiene pass): NOTHING REMOVED HERE, ON PURPOSE.
#
# The audit that pruned 19 lines from device/meizu/m681/proprietary-files.txt
# and 4 lines from meizu_m6 / M6T cannot be executed on this list, because the
# criterion for removal is a byte-level proof that the blob is a build of AOSP
# sources, and THE l681 BLOBS DO NOT EXIST ON THIS DISK (FACT, re-verified
# 2026-09-16: vendor/meizu/l681h/proprietary is an empty directory, there is no
# l681 Flyme dump under /srv/forge/android).  Substituting the m681 binaries to
# get that proof is forbidden by the campaign rule quoted in the header above.
#
# So the 18 lines below are recorded as HYPOTHESIS, not removed.  Every one of
# them names a file whose Android-13 counterpart IS built from source in this
# workspace, taken from the install rules Soong wrote for lineage_m95
# (/srv/forge/android/los20-out/out-m95/soong/installs-lineage_m95.mk,
# `m nothing` rc=0):
#
#   vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/libdrmclearkeyplugin.so      (lines 50, 53)
#   vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/libmockdrmcryptoplugin.so    (lines 51, 54)
#     A13 builds both from frameworks/av/drm into vendor/lib{,64}/mediadrm/ —
#     the same destination.  On the m681, meizu_m6 and M6T dumps the files with
#     these names are the AOSP reference plugins ("ClearKey CDM",
#     clearkeydrm::DrmFactory; "mock-defaultUrl" et al.), and the 32-bit mock
#     plugin is one and the same binary in all three
#     (md5 679f4ea821ca33531585fba8249121b5).
#     => INFERENCE, not FACT, for l681: same tool, same SoC, same Flyme
#     generation, but nobody has read THIS device's bytes.
#
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.primary.default.so   (60, 145)
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.r_submix.default.so  (62, 147)
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio.usb.default.so       (63, 148)
#   lib{,64}/hw/audio_policy.stub.so       (65, 150)
#   lib{,64}/hw/camera.default.so          (66, 151)
#   lib{,64}/soundfx/libaudiopreprocessing.so (144, 229)
#   lib{,64}/librilutils.so                (137, 224)
#     A13 builds every one of these — hardware/libhardware/modules/{audio,
#     audio_remote_submix,usbaudio,camera/3_0}, frameworks/av/media/libeffects/
#     preprocessing, hardware/ril/librilutils — and installs them under
#     /vendor, i.e. into a directory that hw_get_module and the effect loader
#     search BEFORE the /system paths these lines use
#     (hardware/libhardware/hardware.c:39-45,178-190;
#     frameworks/av/media/libeffects/factory/EffectsConfigLoader.c:97,100).
#     On the m681 dump the same names are MediaTek's 2015 builds of that very
#     AOSP source, verbatim hw_module_t .name strings and all.
#     => INFERENCE for l681.  Note that lib/hw/audio.primary.mt6755.so and
#     lib/hw/camera.mt6755.so (the real MT6755 HALs) are separate entries and
#     would stay in any case, exactly as on the m681.
#
# HOW TO TURN THIS INTO A DECISION (the falsifiable step): pull /system off
# REDACTED_UNIT (or find an l681 Flyme image), then for each name above check
# hw_module_t .name / exported symbols against the AOSP sources cited.  Files
# that match AOSP go; anything carrying MediaTek-specific strings stays.  Do
# NOT shortcut this by copying the m681 verdict — that is the same shortcut the
# header of this file forbids for the blobs themselves.
#
# Also left alone, for the record: lib{,64}/hw/audio_policy.default.so (A13
# builds no audio_policy.default at all, so nothing is overridden) and
# lib{,64}/libcamera_client_mtk.so (MediaTek-renamed, no AOSP module of that
# name exists).
